text.hi: किताब कहती है: कल तुम बाज़ार गए थे, उसके बारे में लिखो। पहले मुश्किल शब्द: hustle and bustle = भीड़-भाड़ और चहल-पहल, eateries = खाने की दुकानें, bargaining = मोल-भाव।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: kal tum baazaar gaye the, uske baare mein likho. Pehle mushkil shabd: hustle and bustle = bheed-bhaad aur chahal-pahal, eateries = khaane ki dukaanein, bargaining = mol-bhaav.
text.en: The book says: write about your visit to the market yesterday. First the hard words: hustle and bustle = crowd and noise, eateries = places to eat, bargaining = arguing about the price.

prompt.en: Say that you went to the market yesterday.

steps.answer: Yesterday I went to the market.
There was hustle and bustle everywhere.

meaning.hi: हर जगह भीड़-भाड़ और चहल-पहल थी।
meaning.hinglish: Har jagah bheed-bhaad aur chahal-pahal thi.

meaning.hi: दुकानदार ग्राहकों से मोल-भाव कर रहे थे।
meaning.hinglish: Dukaandaar graahakon se mol-bhaav kar rahe the.

steps.answer: Children enjoyed the swings and the sweet-shops.

meaning.hi: बच्चों ने झूलों और मिठाई की दुकानों का मज़ा लिया।
meaning.hinglish: Bachchon ne jhoolon aur mithaai ki dukaanon ka mazaa liya.

text.hi: पूरा पैराग्राफ़: Yesterday I went to the market. There was hustle and bustle everywhere. Shopkeepers were bargaining with customers. The shops had colourful lighting. Children enjoyed the swings and the sweet-shops. People were eating at the eateries. I bought a toy from a fancy goods shop and clothes for my sister. I had a lot of fun!
